messages:
Zoe (People Ops): Quick ping  we found a small errata in the localized handbook tables (maternity pay percent for IE). Planning a patch publish tomorrow AM. Need manager acks + updated e-sign links.
Harold (HR Ops): Can you paste the errata here? I want to check impact on open offers.
Zoe (People Ops): Sure  the IE table line for "Statutory pay" should read 60% (was 50%). No impact to base contracts but JD benefit bullets need an update if they cite the table.
Marta (EMEA Partner): Thanks Zoe, Ill sweep active EMEA reqs and tag owners if they mention "statutory pay" or a hard number.
Priam (Legal): Small note  any published correction for IE should include the statutory reference link and a one-line note about retroactive interpretations. Ill add the phrasing to the doc.
Zoe (People Ops): Added legal note and updated the localized PDF draft. Manager ack flow: simple e-sign + a 10min manager-only drop-in. Sheet: https://sheets.goo.gl/rwd-errata-acks
Harold (HR Ops): Scheduling drop-ins: tomorrow 0900 UTC and 1500 UTC. Recordings posted. Invite includes e-sign link.
Marta (EMEA Partner): I'll take the 0900 UTC slot and chase any managers in IE directly.
Zoe (People Ops): Manager checklist for sheet (paste into row):
```
- Review errata note with Legal
- Complete e-sign correction ack
- Confirm no JD or offer language references old number
```
SignoffBot: Auto-update: 7/35 managers acknowledged, 2 sessions scheduled, e-sign link sent in invites.
Harold (HR Ops): Ops ask: hiring ops, pause any reposts that include benefits snippets until we confirm updated JD copy. Tag me if you need help updating templates.
Marta (EMEA Partner): Will scan and tag owners now. Found 2 open reqs that reference 50%  tagging @harold.
Priam (Legal): I dropped the statutory reference link + a one-line retroactive note in the doc under section 3.1. Zoe, should we include a short FAQ item?
Zoe (People Ops): Yes please add 2 bullets and I'll paste into the handbook errata section. Final deadline for manager acks: 48h after publish. Ill post a summary in #general when we go live. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
Harold (HR Ops): Thanks team  will follow up with hiring ops and push the JD updates.
Marta (EMEA Partner): On it. Sending manager reminders in 1h. :thumbsup:
